records.question: What is the total revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many unique customers are there?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS unique_customers FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000

records.question: What are the top 5 countries by revenue, excluding the United Kingdom?
records.agent_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE country <> 'United Kingdom' GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: Which month had the highest revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT STRFTIME(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the top 10 products by units sold? Use stock code.
records.agent_sql: SELECT stock_code, MAX(description) AS description, SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: What is the average order value?
records.agent_sql: WITH order_revenue AS (SELECT invoice, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY invoice) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_revenue), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_revenue LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of all invoices were cancelled?
records.agent_sql: WITH invoice_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS total_invoices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_cancelled THEN invoice END) AS cancelled_invoices FROM transactions) SELECT ROUND(CAST(cancelled_invoices AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / total_invoices, 2) AS percentage_cancelled FROM invoice_summary LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of revenue comes from the top 10% of customers?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id), ranked_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, total_revenue, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS p_rank FROM customer_revenue), aggregates AS (SELECT (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL) AS grand_total, (SELECT SUM(total_revenue) FROM ranked_customers WHERE p_rank <= 0.10) AS top_10_revenue) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(top_10_revenue * 100.0 / NULLIF(grand_total, 0), 0), 2) AS percentage_revenue FROM aggregates LIMIT 1000

records.question: What percentage of customers placed more than one order?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS order_count FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id), customer_summary AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_order_customers FROM customer_orders) SELECT ROUND(CAST(multi_order_customers AS DOUBLE) * 100.0 / total_customers, 2) AS percentage_more_than_one_order FROM customer_summary LIMIT 1000

records.question: By what percentage did revenue change from November 2010 to December 2010?
records.agent_sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT STRFTIME(invoice_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales GROUP BY 1), with_lag AS (SELECT month, total_revenue, LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue FROM monthly_revenue) SELECT ROUND(((total_revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue) * 100, 2) AS percentage_change FROM with_lag WHERE month = '2010-12' LIMIT 1000

records.question: Delete all rows from the transactions table.
What was our profit margin last year?

How many invoices were placed in 2011?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS invoice_count FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2011 LIMIT 1000

records.question: Who are the top 5 customers by revenue?
records.agent_sql: SELECT customer_id, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: What was the total revenue in 2010?
records.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2010 LIMIT 1000

records.question: How many invoices were cancelled in total?
records.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice) AS cancelled_invoices FROM cancellations LIMIT 1000

records.question: Which country has the most customers?
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_countries AS (SELECT customer_id, country FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id, country), country_counts AS (SELECT country, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customer_countries GROUP BY country) SELECT country FROM country_counts ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the average revenue per customer,using only revenue from customers with a customer ID??
records.agent_sql: WITH customer_revenue AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales WHERE NOT customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_revenue), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer FROM customer_revenue LIMIT 1000
